<reason>B won a close, high-quality debate by turning A’s honest concession—that names still issue over objection—into a clean ballot. B showed later contact rules cannot restore anonymity, that medical history can move without identity, and that a proven-threat pause still unmasks the hard cases sealing was built for. A’s adulthood and unremediable-ignorance weighing stayed live, but did not repair the knowledge/contact split.</reason>
<best_rebuttal>B’s sequence attack: a released name cannot be put back, so A’s fence of no-contact orders fails and “finding living kin” is contact smuggled in as medicine.</best_rebuttal>
